relationships.evidence_quote: the same dose of the combination treatment, did not reduce Lef1 nuclear staining in the AOA mice, while the opposite result was observed for the young female PTOA mice

key_findings: Combined Sirt1 cleavage blockade (CA074me) plus SRT1720 improved knee hyperalgesia in both aged and post-traumatic OA female mice
Structural benefit and Lef1/Col1a1 reduction occurred only in PTOA, not age-associated OA; p16INK4A was unchanged
